title: CleanBedwars
description: CleanBedWars is a modern, polished, and performance-focused BedWars plugin for Paper servers. It offers smart arena setup, clean gameplay systems, and a smooth, familiar BedWars experience for both server owners and players.
body:
# CleanBedWars

**CleanBedWars** is a modern BedWars plugin for **Paper** servers, built to be clean, polished, easy to set up, and smooth to play. It is designed for server owners who want a familiar BedWars experience with modern UI, strong performance, and straightforward arena management.

## What it adds

CleanBedWars adds a full BedWars minigame system to your server, including:

- Arena creation and setup tools
- Team-based BedWars matches
- Join, shop, and upgrades NPCs
- Scoreboards, tab list support, and holograms
- Team, diamond, and emerald generators
- Shops, upgrades, traps, and spectator features
- Arena reset and return-to-lobby flow
- Optional proxy support for network setups

## Features

### Easy arena setup
CleanBedWars is built around a simple setup flow that makes creating arenas much easier.

You can configure:
- waiting spawns
- spectator spawns
- team spawns
- beds
- generators
- shop and upgrades NPCs
- join NPCs
- waiting regions
- return spawn

It is designed so arenas are quick to create and easy to manage.

### Familiar BedWars gameplay
The plugin provides the core BedWars experience players expect, including:
- teams and beds
- respawning while your bed is alive
- spectator mode when eliminated
- generators and forge upgrades
- item shop and team upgrades
- sudden death / bed break timers
- arena reset after the game ends

### Clean UI and polished presentation
CleanBedWars focuses heavily on presentation and usability.

It includes:
- clean scoreboards
- polished menus
- holograms above important NPCs and generators
- join menus and arena selectors
- spectator hotbar tools
- improved lobby items and match flow

### Performance-focused design
The plugin is made to stay smooth and lightweight, even on smaller servers.

It is built with a focus on:
- clean match flow
- efficient NPC handling
- lightweight UI updates
- practical arena management
- minimizing unnecessary lag and clutter

### Proxy-ready support
CleanBedWars can also be configured for proxy-based setups when needed, making it suitable for both standalone servers and larger network environments.

## Why download CleanBedWars?

You should download CleanBedWars if you want a BedWars plugin that is:

- easy to set up
- clean and modern
- familiar for players
- polished in presentation
- efficient and lightweight
- suitable for both small servers and larger setups

CleanBedWars aims to give server owners a manageable and reliable BedWars system, while giving players a smooth and enjoyable gameplay experience.

## Platform

- **Server software:** Paper
- **Recommended use:** BedWars minigame servers, public servers, private servers, and networks
